identifiers._comment: Derived from app.slug by default. Only override if you must avoid a name collision on a shared host. These drive Docker image tags, container names, the shared network, the Celery/Redis key prefix and the database name — i.e. everything that keeps stacks isolated on one machine.

support._comment: Support channels shown on the Help page. The Viber floating button is opt-in: set viber.enabled true and a real number to show it on every admin screen.

billing._comment: mode = managed | api | disabled. Under 'managed', plans live in the Partner Dashboard and this catalog is the local mirror (handles + ranks + entitlements). 'shopifyPlanName' must match the Partner-Dashboard plan name so it normalizes back to the handle.

featureFlags._comment: Per-tenant flags, default off. Ship the framework with one example; each app adds its own keys.
